summary: Iteration 7 — End-to-end testing of (1) de-hardcoded solver, (2) role-flag chips + staff delete dialog, (3) override-conflict dialog on /requests with audit log. ALL 10 PYTEST + ALL FRONTEND CHECKS PASS. grep for staff-initial literals in rota_solver.py / rota_validator.py / rule_definitions.py returns ZERO hits. solver/test_runner.py runs clean. POST /api/solver/generate succeeds in <15s. /api/staff returns 8 with complete role flags (J.C.=mgr, L.M.=dep+sen, L.D.=sen, D.A./T.D.=flexi, C.E./A.A./J.R.=night). PUT /api/staff/{id} persists a single-flag patch. GET /api/staff/{id}/references returns leave_count/assignments_count/requests_count/active_tokens_count + rule_references[{rule_id,mode}]. PATCH /api/requests/{id} status=accepted on a clashing row returns 409 with detail={error,reason,existing_leave}; with override_conflict=true but missing reason returns 422; with both fields returns 200 and writes a row to audit_log (GET /api/audit-log?action=override_conflict returns reverse-chron rows with actor_email=manager@grizedale.local). POST /api/requests/bulk returns {updated,skipped_conflicts} and pushes all rows through when override_conflict+reason supplied. Public /check endpoint regression OK. Frontend: Staff page renders MGR/DEP/SEN/FLX/NGT color-coded chips; toggle surfaces toast and persists. StaffDeleteDialog fetches /references and shows counts + 'I understand' ack checkbox. Requests page shows '✓ Open' or '⚠ <initials>' Conflicts badge; clicking Accept on a clashing row opens OverrideConflictDialog with reason textarea + ack checkbox (confirm disabled until both filled); confirming writes PATCH with override fields and creates audit row.

critical_code_review_comments: De-hardcoding complete: _derive_role_staff() drives every rule; grep for staff initials in the three solver files returns zero matches.
server.py /api/requests/{id} PATCH cleanly separates 409 (no override) from 422 (override without reason) from 200 (override with reason). _log_audit writes non-fatally.
StaffDeleteDialog correctly uses /references counts + rule_references list with SOFT/HARD badges; ack checkbox gates the Delete button.
OverrideConflictDialog correctly disables confirm until reason + ack both filled, and forwards override_conflict/override_reason on both single-patch and bulk paths.
/api/requests/bulk contract (updated[] + skipped_conflicts[]) is consistent with the single-patch path and matches the spec.
Audit rows sort reverse-chron via timestamp server-side — verified.
